title: New Teeth Now
description: newteethnow.com 2420 over 707,000 files. New Teeth Now is a dental implant center in Lakeland, Florida famous for same day full mouth restoration, patients leave the same afternoon with a complete set of new teeth. Board certified surgeons Harley Richards and David Kirkpatrick have placed over 30000 implants in 30 years. The specialty is zygomatic implants anchored in the cheekbone for patients with severe bone loss rejected elsewhere, with no bone grafting and an All on X method using four to eight titanium Neodent implants per jaw. All work is under one roof in a 16000 sq ft center with an in house zirconia lab and general anesthesia. Pricing is all inclusive, zygomatic implants cost about 2000 to 4000 dollars each, financing through LendingClub and CareCredit is guaranteed. Patients come from all 50 states and abroad, four clinics in Florida and San Diego. Since 2022 owned by Frontline Dental Implant Specialists, a Leon Capital backed network.
